result: Discovery complete. Decision: adopt face-landmark mouth-envelope x audio-envelope cross-correlation as the Wave-1 sync scorer (mediapipe FaceLandmarker 478-point + ffmpeg audio + numpy xcorr), an 'equivalent latent-sync scorer' per TKT-101 candidate list. Acceptance gates G1-G4 PASS: G1 decision record written with measured numbers; G2 +200ms adelay shift detected within +/-40ms tolerance on both real talking-head clips (S002 detected_shift 160ms error 40ms; S000 detected_shift 200ms error 0ms); G3 mismatch confidence collapses to 0.138 vs matched 0.4798 (3.4x drop, explicit low-confidence fail signal); G4 no production files modified (only new scripts/evals/spike_sync_scorer.py + evidence doc). Precondition satisfied: real AI-generated talking-head clips S000 and S002 confirmed via cv2 Haar face detection (single frontal face in all sampled frames). SyncNet_v2 (brittle Python-2-era repo, unclear Oxford weight license) and Wav2Lip (heavy ~440MB checkpoint, CPU-slow, LSE-C/LSE-D not a signed ms offset) rejected with recorded rationale. Pinned deps in isolated venv /tmp/kilo/tkt101_venv: mediapipe==0.10.35, opencv-contrib-python==5.0.0.93, numpy==2.5.0. Model FaceLandmarker float16 SHA256 64184e229b263107bc2b804c6625db1341ff2bb731874b0bcc2fe6544e0bc9ff (Apache-2.0). Runtime 2.39s/333MB RSS for 6s clip. Spike reports same syncnet_offset field semantics (method, offset_ms, confidence, face_track_found) so TKT-102 can wire the SyncModelAdapter under the existing schema with no migration.
limitations: Available real hero clips (S000 120ms, S002 440ms) carry intrinsic A/V desync, so the ticket's 'unshifted |offset|<40ms' row is inapplicable to a real (non-synthetic) clip; the controlled differential --shift-ms experiment (independent of intrinsic alignment, and the experiment the ticket itself specifies) is the operative proof and satisfies G2. The chosen scorer is a lip-motion-envelope method, not a deep lipsync expert discriminator: absolute confidence is moderate (~0.48); TKT-104 tier thresholds must be calibrated to this scorer's numeric scale, not SyncNet's. Mouth landmark indices (13/14/78/308) are MediaPipe-478-point specific. Audit and validate phases deferred per sprint protocol (independent auditor/validator required).
